blocks.text: RAMON MAGSAYSAY, Zamboanga del Sur — What began nearly two decades ago as a modest local association in Barangay Bobongan here has grown into a major engine driving Zamboanga Peninsula’s sustainable bamboo-based furniture making industry. The Ramon Magsaysay Bamboo Producers Cooperative (RAMAGBA) stands as the region’s sole bamboo processing facility capable of manufacturing engineered bamboo — a vital development positioning the municipality as the “Bamboo Capital of Zamboanga del Sur.” To scale up operations and strengthen its commercial footprint, the association officially transitioned into a cooperative on Jan. 7, 2025.
